An Ordinance further to amend the Removal from Service
(Special Powers) Ordinance, 2000)
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 7th November, 2001]
F. No. 2(1)/2001-Pub.---The
following Ordinance promulgated by the President is hereby published for
general information:
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Removal from Service
(Special Powers) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Removal from Service Special Powers Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Insertion of new sections 14-A and 14-B Ordinance XVII of 2000

ORDINANCE LXII OF 2001
ORDINANCE LXII OF
2001
REMOVAL FROM
SERVICE (SPECIAL POWERS)
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2001
An Ordinance further to amend the Removal from Service
(Special Powers) Ordinance, 2000)
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 7th November, 2001]
F. No. 2(1)/2001-Pub.---The
following Ordinance promulgated by the President is hereby published for
general information:
2. Insertion of new sections
14A and 14B Ordinance XVII of 2000.--In the Removal from Service (Special
Powers) Ordinance, 2000 (XVII of 2000), after section 14 the following new
sections shall be inserted, namely:--
"14A. Indemnity.---No
suit, prosecution or other legal proceedings shall lie against the competent
authority or an officer or authority authorized by it for anything which is in
good faith done or intended to be done under this Ordinance or the rules,
instructions or directions made or issued thereunder.
14B. Jurisdiction barred.---Save
as provided under this Ordinance, no order made or proceedings taken under this
Ordinance, or the rules made thereunder by the competent authority or any
officer or authority authorized by it shall be called in question in any Court
and no injunction shall be granted by any Court in respect of any decision made
or proceedings taken in pursuance of any power conferred by, or under, this
Ordinance, or the rules made thereunder.".
